mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) is growing, the combination signals a robust supply side and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of INDPRO and GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.
